links.comparator_used: Purely statistical 'optimal' cutoff selection, compared with a governance-informed threshold using prevalence-adjusted metrics and provider capacity modeling
links.outcome: Operational feasibility of alert volume and missed-event (miss) rate across candidate thresholds
links.effect: No numeric values given in the abstract; statistically optimal thresholds may produce operationally infeasible alert volumes or unacceptable miss rates
links.tradeoff: Choosing a threshold involves a trade-off between downstream provider workload (alert volume) and missed events; it also needs value judgments and stakeholder input.
links.quote: We demonstrate that statistically optimal thresholds may produce operationally infeasible alert volumes or unacceptable miss rates.

design_hint: alert threshold selection with capacity modeling and governance
